description: This Java class 'SimpleRequestResponseResult' extends 'RequestResponseResult<Buffer>' and encapsulates a simple response result with a status code and payload. It provides a static factory method 'from' to create instances of itself.

classes.name: SimpleRequestResponseResult
classes.description: A result that contains a status code and a string payload, extending 'RequestResponseResult<Buffer>'.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new 'SimpleRequestResponseResult' instance with specified status, payload, cache directive, and application properties.
